description: Give Rove a starting URL and a goal; its agent browses public pages (at most a few) and returns an answer with sources. By default waits for the result; if the timeout passes it returns status "running" with a runId. Status "waiting" means the agent paused (e.g. needs more input) rather than finished.

outputFormat.description: Desired answer format, e.g. "JSON with fields name, price". Defaults to JSON.

task.description: What Rove should find or do, in plain language

timeoutSec.description: Maximum seconds to wait when wait=true

url.description: Public http(s) URL to start from

wait.description: Wait for the result (true) or return immediately with the runId (false)

name: rove_run_task
title: Run a goal-based browsing task
